response_header_transform_rules.description: Set nosniff, Referrer-Policy, conditional CSP (omit sandbox CSP on application/pdf so Chromium PDF viewer renders), Cache-Control for /viewer-publications/*, /bodies/sha256/*, and /exports/*, and map ?filename= to Content-Disposition.

rules.description: Set nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and immutable Cache-Control on content-addressed R2 objects
rules.expression: (http.host eq "congressional-data.spicygov.ai") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bodies/sha256/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/viewer-publications/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/viewer-publications/catalogs/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/exports/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/exports/snapshots/"))

rules.description: Set nosniff, Referrer-Policy, sandbox CSP, and Cache-Control: no-store on top-level manifest selectors
rules.expression: (http.host eq "congressional-data.spicygov.ai") and (http.request.uri.path eq "/viewer-publications/manifest.json" or http.request.uri.path eq "/exports/manifest.json" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/recovery-status.json") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/exports/") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/manifest.json") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/latest.json")) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/exports/releases/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/exports/snapshots/")))

rules.description: Set sandbox CSP on non-PDF responses
rules.expression: (http.host eq "congressional-data.spicygov.ai") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/viewer-publications/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bodies/sha256/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/exports/")) and not starts_with(lower(http.response.content_type.media_type), "application/pdf")

rules.description: Set inline RFC 6266 Content-Disposition from ?filename= on PDF bodies
rules.expression: (http.host eq "congressional-data.spicygov.ai") and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bodies/sha256/") and len(http.request.uri.args["filename"]) > 0 and len(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0]) <= 128 and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "%") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\"") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\\") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], ";") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "/") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "..") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\r") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\n") and starts_with(lower(http.response.content_type.media_type), "application/pdf")

rules.description: Set attachment RFC 6266 Content-Disposition from ?filename= on non-PDF bodies
rules.expression: (http.host eq "congressional-data.spicygov.ai") and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bodies/sha256/") and len(http.request.uri.args["filename"]) > 0 and len(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0]) <= 128 and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "%") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\"") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\\") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], ";") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "/") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "..") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\r") and not contains(http.request.uri.args["filename"][0], "\n") and not starts_with(lower(http.response.content_type.media_type), "application/pdf")
